title: 2024 AMC 10A Problem 18
statement: There are exactly \(K\) positive integers \(b\) with \(5 \le b \le 2024\) such that the base-\(b\) integer \(2024_b\) is divisible by \(16\) (where \(16\) is in base ten). What is the sum of the digits of \(K?\)

solutions.text: In base \(b,\) \(2024_b = 2b^3 + 2b + 4\) \(= 2(b^3 + b + 2),\) so \(2024_b\) is divisible by \(16\) exactly when \(b^3 + b + 2\) is divisible by \(8.\) Test the residues modulo \(8:\) this holds precisely for \(b \equiv 3, 6, 7 \pmod 8.\) Counting the \(b\) with \(5 \le b \le 2024\) in those three classes gives \(K = 758,\) whose digit sum is \(7 + 5 + 8 = 20.\) Therefore, the answer is D.
hints: \(2024_b = 2b^3 + 2b + 4;\) dividing by \(16\) requires \(b^3 + b + 2\) to be divisible by \(8\)
Check \(b \bmod 8;\) the residues \(3, 6, 7\) work, so count those \(b\) in \([5, 2024]\)
